body:
## Code Review

This pull request introduces a script to materialize Wave 1 precise SourceFigureAsset crops from source-page renders, along with its corresponding test suite and generated artifact files. The code reviewer provided several high-quality recommendations to improve robustness and prevent diff churn. Specifically, the feedback suggests handling null keys and using deterministic JSON-array serialization for storage keys, gracefully handling missing or malformed critical input artifacts to fail closed with diagnostics, and strictly sorting all generated JSON arrays lexicographically by their ID fields. Additionally, the reviewer recommended updating the unit tests to explicitly assert that validator checks are emitted in strict byte-order and to include fail-closed test cases for missing or malformed inputs.
